note: Minimum wages for 2027 as the official government pages said them on the read date, for the states and cities this guide covers. A row with wage_2027 null means the page gave no 2027 figure yet; the 2026 rate stays until it does. Each row quotes the page. Rates change, so confirm on the page. The paycheck page swaps a preset to its 2027 rate on the effective date; the rules page table is edited by hand (issue 7).

rows.name: California (statewide)
rows.page_title: ICYMI: California's minimum wage set to increase to $17.40 per hour on January 1, 2027 | California Department of Industrial Relations
rows.quote: Beginning January 1, 2027, California's statewide minimum wage will increase to $17.40 per hour
rows.youth: Same rate for teens. Learners with no related experience may be paid 85 percent for their first 160 hours.

rows.name: Washington
rows.page_title: Minimum Wage | Washington State Department of Labor and Industries
rows.quote: The new minimum wage for 2027 will be $17.73 an hour for most workers. The minimum wage for 14-and 15-year-old workers will be $15.07 an hour. These changes take effect Jan. 1, 2027.
rows.youth: Ages 14 and 15: $15.07 an hour (85 percent) from Jan 1, 2027.

rows.name: Oregon
rows.page_title: BOLI : Oregon Minimum Wage : For Workers : State of Oregon
rows.quote: For July 1, 2026, through June 30, 2027, those rates are: $16.80 per hour - Portland metro ... $15.55 per hour - Standard ... $14.55 per hour - Non-urban
rows.youth: The minimum wage is the same for adults and for minors.
rows.status: The July 1, 2027 rates are set each spring from inflation and were not posted on Oct 18, 2026. The July 2026 rates ($16.80 Portland metro, $15.55 standard, $14.55 non-urban) run through June 30, 2027.

rows.name: Colorado
rows.page_title: Labor Rules, Proposed and Adopted | Colorado Department of Labor and Employment
rows.quote: Proposed PAY CALC Rules (proposed_2027_pay_calc_order_7_ccr_1103-14_9.30.2026)
rows.status: On Oct 18, 2026 the 2027 PAY CALC Order was only a proposed rule (dated Sept 30, 2026), not adopted, and the number was not on the page. The adopted 2026 order ($15.16, per the U.S. Department of Labor table) stands until the 2027 order is adopted. Denver sets its own higher rate.

rows.name: New York
rows.page_title: Minimum Wage | New York State Department of Labor
rows.quote: On January 1, 2027, New York's minimum wage will stay the same. The minimum wage rates will be: $17.00 per hour in New York City, Long Island, and Westchester County; $16.00 per hour in the rest of New York State
rows.status: No change: an inflation off-ramp in the law was met for 2027. New York City, Long Island and Westchester stay at $17.00; the rest of the state at $16.00.

rows.name: Illinois
rows.page_title: Minimum Wage Law - Fair Labor Standards Division | Illinois Department of Labor
rows.quote: Guarantees a minimum wage of $15.00 per hour for workers 18 years of age and older. ... YOUTHS (UNDER 18) (WORKING LESS THAN 650 HOURS PER CALENDAR YEAR) $13
rows.youth: Under 18 and under 650 hours in a calendar year: $13.00 an hour.
rows.status: The state page lists no 2027 change ($15.00 is the law's final step). Chicago and Cook County set higher rates each July 1.

rows.name: Georgia
rows.page_title: State Minimum Wage Laws | U.S. Department of Labor
rows.quote: Updated July 1, 2026
rows.status: Georgia's own rate is $5.15 for employers with 6 or more workers; employers covered by federal law pay the federal $7.25. No 2027 change is announced.

rows.name: Texas
rows.page_title: Texas Minimum Wage Law - Texas Workforce Commission
rows.quote: The Texas Minimum Wage Act: Sets a minimum wage for non-exempt employees.
rows.status: Texas adopts the federal $7.25 an hour. No 2027 change is announced.

rows.name: Arizona
rows.page_title: Labor - Minimum Wage Main Page | Industrial Commission of Arizona
rows.quote: AZ State Minimum Wage Poster 2026 (English)
rows.status: The Industrial Commission page listed only the 2026 poster on Oct 18, 2026. Arizona adjusts for inflation each Jan 1 and usually posts the new rate in mid October. Flagstaff and Tucson set their own rates.

rows.name: British Columbia
rows.page_title: Minimum wage - Province of British Columbia
rows.quote: As of June 1, 2026, minimum wage is $18.25 per hour. ... Every year since June 1, 2024, each minimum wage goes up by the same percentage as the BC All-Items Consumer Price Index (CPI)
rows.status: C$18.25 runs to May 31, 2027. The June 1, 2027 rate follows BC CPI and was not posted on Oct 18, 2026.

rows.name: Palo Alto
rows.page_title: Minimum Wage - City of Palo Alto, CA
rows.quote: Effective January 1, 2027, the minimum wage rate for the City of Palo Alto is $19.25 per hour.

rows.name: San Francisco
rows.page_title: Minimum Wage Ordinance | SF.gov
rows.quote: currently $19.61 as of July 1, 2026 ... Minimum Wage Poster - effective July 1, 2026 - June 30, 2027
rows.status: $19.61 runs through June 30, 2027; the July 1, 2027 rate follows the CPI and was not posted.

rows.name: Berkeley
rows.page_title: Workforce Standards and Enforcement | City of Berkeley
rows.quote: $19.61/hour: Effective July 1, 2026
rows.status: No 2027 figure on the page; Berkeley adjusts each July 1.

rows.name: Alameda
rows.page_title: Minimum Wage | City of Alameda
rows.quote: $17.76/hour July 1, 2026; Adjusted Annually by the Consumer Price Index (CPI-W) July 1, 2027
rows.status: The July 1, 2027 amount is not published.

rows.name: Fremont
rows.page_title: Minimum Wage | City of Fremont, CA Official Website
rows.quote: 2026 $18.05; 2027 2026 wage plus inflation adjustment
rows.status: The city publishes the July 1, 2027 rate by April 1, 2027. Non-profit employers are exempt from the city rate.

rows.name: Oakland
rows.page_title: Download Minimum Wage and Hotel Wage Posters | City of Oakland, CA
rows.quote: Measure FF: Effective January 1, 2026, the Oakland Minimum Wage Rate goes up to $17.34 per hour.
rows.status: The 2027 poster was not posted on Oct 18, 2026.

rows.name: San Jose
rows.page_title: Minimum Wage Ordinance | City of San Jose
rows.quote: POSTERS: 2026 OFFICIAL MINIMUM WAGE BULLETIN
rows.status: The page's rate table ends at 2025 and links the 2026 bulletin ($18.45 per the UC Berkeley Labor Center inventory); no 2027 bulletin yet.

rows.name: Sunnyvale
rows.page_title: Minimum Wage in Sunnyvale | Sunnyvale, CA
rows.quote: Effective Date: Jan. 1, 2026 Minimum Wage Rate: $19.50 per hour
rows.status: No 2027 figure yet; the city adjusts each Jan 1 by the regional CPI.

rows.name: Mountain View
rows.page_title: Mountain View Minimum Wage Ordinance | Mountain View, CA - EconDev
rows.quote: The Minimum Wage rate is annually updated in the Fall for the next calendar year. The calculated rate for 2026 Calendar year will be $19.70.
rows.status: Page last updated Oct 23, 2025; the 2027 rate was not posted on Oct 18, 2026.

rows.name: Emeryville
rows.page_title: Minimum Wage Ordinance - City of Emeryville, CA
rows.quote: 2026 Minimum Wage and Paid Sick Leave Poster
rows.status: The page text gives no number (the rate is in the 2026 poster PDF: $20.34 from July 1, 2026 per the UC Berkeley Labor Center inventory). No 2027 figure yet.
